name: FlyLab
description: Agent-first WebMCP virtual Drosophila neuroethology lab with a visible supervisor audit surface.

discovery.unsupported_browser_behavior: Read-only manifest, exact tool schemas, and inline state remain available. This does not polyfill WebMCP or make tools callable; execution requires a browser and workspace where document.modelContext is available.

tools.name: inspect_flylab_state
tools.purpose: Recover the exact shared revision, artifact IDs, blocker, and next valid action.

tools.name: find_fly_circuits
tools.purpose: Search the bounded source-backed adult circuit catalog.

tools.name: draft_fly_hypothesis
tools.purpose: Create a falsifiable agent_hypothesized claim from eligible evidence.

tools.name: design_stimulation_trial
tools.purpose: Create controlled conditions, timing, seeds, and model assumptions.

tools.name: run_fly_simulation
tools.purpose: Run the exact approved deterministic virtual experiment.

tools.name: analyze_fly_behavior
tools.purpose: Compute the complete predefined five-metric behavior panel.

tools.name: compare_fly_trials
tools.purpose: Rank conditions and propose, but never execute, one bounded follow-up.

tools.name: save_fly_evidence
tools.purpose: Commit the exact source-to-result lineage and portable JSON envelope.

supervisor_gate.name: visible_supervisor_approval
supervisor_gate.boundary: Approval is absent from the WebMCP tool surface and requires visible UI interaction. It is not identity-authenticated against general browser automation.

recovery.rule: Call inspect_flylab_state after interruption, edit, cancellation, stale-state failure, or navigation.
recovery.mutation_guard: Every successful tool call returns a shared state revision; prepared long-running work cannot commit against a changed revision.

scientific_scope.boundary: Hand-authored, uncalibrated reduced-order simulation; not neural dynamics, FlyGym execution, a wet-lab experiment, or biological validation.
